claim_one_line: THE SEAM IS NOT A THIRD FACE -- ITS HILBERT CLASS FIELD IS THE TWO ENDS. THE CHAIN's C7 banks the object's forced quadratic faces as exactly three, a Klein four-group: being Q(sqrt-3), hearing Q(sqrt5), meeting Q(sqrt-15). B334 says something strictly stronger and is carried by NO curated consolidation: the Hilbert class field of the seam Q(sqrt-15) IS EXACTLY Q(sqrt5, sqrt-3), the compositum of the two ends. So the third face is NOT an independent third thing -- it is the field whose class field is the other two, and the Klein four-group is two faces plus a class-field closure rather than three faces plus a relation. RE-VERIFIED HERE, elementary and self-contained, no external tables: sqrt5*sqrt-3 = sqrt-15; disc Q(sqrt5) = 5 and disc Q(sqrt-3) = -3 are both PRIME discriminants whose product is -15, and that is the unique decomposition of -15 into prime discriminants, which is WHY the factorisation is forced rather than chosen; h(Q(sqrt-15)) = 2 by counting reduced primitive forms of discriminant -15, giving [(1,1,4),(2,1,2)]; genus theory with t = 2 prime discriminants gives a genus field of degree 2^(t-1) = 2 over the seam, EQUAL to h, so the genus field IS the Hilbert class field; and Q(sqrt5, sqrt-3) has degree 4 over Q hence degree 2 over Q(sqrt-15), matching. WHY IT MATTERS TO THE PROGRAMME'S OWN THESIS: THE_FRAMEWORK Layer 1 presents the two ends as GEOMETRY (the cone-angle transition through all three curvature signs), while B332 -- also uncited, registered as L156 by B1027 -- derives the same two ends ALGEBRAICALLY from the two letters (R*L has disc 5, -R*L^-1 has disc -3). B1029 adds the third leg: given the two ends, the seam is forced by class field theory. The Klein four-group of faces therefore has THREE INDEPENDENT DERIVATIONS -- geometric (B248), combinatorial (B332), arithmetic (B334) -- AND ONLY THE FIRST IS ON A CURATED SURFACE. NO NOVELTY WHATSOEVER IS CLAIMED: genus theory is Gauss, and that the genus field of a discriminant with two prime-discriminant factors is the compositum of those quadratic fields is textbook; the content is that this classical fact is what pins the object's third face and that no consolidation says so. No physics -- these are number fields attached to the object's arithmetic, nothing more. C7 is NOT corrected but SHARPENED: three faces forming a Klein four-group is true; the addition is that one of the three is determined by the other two. 7 locks including an MB12 control (disc -23, h = 3 odd, where the genus field is strictly smaller than the Hilbert class field, so the reasoning cannot be applied blindly). Gate 5 untouched.
